description:
Before the show, get into the mood.

A quiet countdown for your next concert, festival, or livehouse. Not a ticket wallet. Not an itinerary. Just a private space to slowly get closer to this one night.

Save your first 5 shows for free, then grow your free capacity by 1 show each calendar month. A Home Screen widget can keep the countdown in sight.

BeforeShow helps you:
• See the next show — the home screen holds one current show and its countdown
• Light reminders — only using facts you already saved
• Bring a show in — paste a link, scan a screenshot, or type it yourself
• Keep the night — a short rating, a note, and memory fragments that stay yours
• Home Screen widgets — see how long is left without opening the app

How it works
1. Save your next concert, festival, or livehouse
2. Watch the countdown as the night gets closer
3. After the show, leave something behind and find it later in Footprints

The free plan starts with capacity for 5 saved shows, then can grow by 1 show each calendar month; deleting a show frees capacity. Pro is a yearly subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase, and unlocks unlimited new shows. Eligible users can try Pro free for 3 days. Prices are shown in the App Store at purchase.

Terms of Use: https://beforeshow.doublewaterapps.com/terms/
Privacy Policy: https://beforeshow.doublewaterapps.com/privacy/
promotionalText: Smoother Listening, editable Footprints, and clearer countdown widgets — get closer to your next live night.
whatsNew:
Listening keeps you closer to the night — popular show compilations now flow across volumes, and opening the lid no longer loses your place on the track.

New
• Edit a show and jump into memory fragments right from Footprints detail
• Add or update your post-show rating and note after the lights go down
• Redeem a code from the membership screen when you have one

Improved
• Tap the CD in Listening to open album details and explore the setlist
• Home Screen countdown widgets stay readable past the 10-hour mark
• Widget setup now shows a live preview with clearer steps
• Artist search and matching on Apple Music feel faster and more accurate
• Gentle prompts on the countdown card and alerts point you to features you haven’t tried yet
